# Story 28 — Quick Replies & Team Collaboration (Story: CRM-59)

## Prerequisites

- Story completing **DASH-001 / DASH-003** dashboard shell and role guards.
- Ticket messaging endpoints and internal-note support already in place from **TKT-008** (see `backend/CRM.Api/Tickets/TicketMessageEndpoints.cs` and `frontend/CRM.Web/src/modules/tickets/components/TicketMessagesSection.vue`).
- Ticket history integration from **TKT-009** (see `backend/CRM.Api/Tickets/TicketHistoryEntry.cs` and the history writer used inside `TicketEndpoints.cs`).
- Auth roles from **AUTH-001 / AUTH-003** (see `backend/CRM.Api/Auth/Roles.cs`).
- Coordinate with the owner of the ticket module before adding a new `MessageMention` table — the intake mandates inspecting existing architecture first.

---

## Story Goal

Add two independent, MVP-simple productivity features to the ticket workspace:

1. **Quick Replies** — shared, managed by Admin/Manager, usable by Agent. A CRUD API plus a searchable selector inside the ticket message composer that **inserts** (never sends) content into the textarea.
2. **Team Collaboration** — reuse existing internal-note messages from **TKT-008**; extend them to carry validated user mentions (`@user`) so mentioned agents can be resolved server-side. Internal notes and mentions must never appear on customer-facing responses.

**Out of scope:** WebSockets, presence, real-time chat, AI-generated replies, full notification service, per-user personal quick replies (unless SDD requires — this plan treats replies as shared only), rich mention editor.

## Product rules (from story)

- **Current behaviour:** Ticket messages support `Reply` and `InternalNote` types with plain-text content; no shared quick replies exist; mentions are plain-text only (no server-side validation).
- **New behaviour:**
  - Admin/Manager can CRUD shared **Quick Replies**. Agent can list and use them.
  - Quick reply selection **inserts** content into the composer textarea — no automatic send.
  - Internal-note creation accepts a validated `mentionedUserIds` array. Backend rejects unknown/inactive users. Duplicates are deduped server-side.
  - Internal notes and mentions remain **server-enforced CRM-only** and are excluded from any customer-facing surface.
  - A ticket history entry is created when an internal note is added, using the existing history writer (TKT-009).

### 3 — Quick Reply endpoints

**Create file:** `backend/CRM.Api/QuickReplies/QuickReplyEndpoints.cs`

- `GET /api/quick-replies?search=` → any authenticated user with role `Admin | Manager | Agent`. Filters by `IsActive == true` and case-insensitive substring on `Title` or `Content`. Returns array ordered by `Title`.
- `POST /api/quick-replies` → `Admin, Manager`. Validate `Title` non-empty ≤ 120, `Content` non-empty ≤ 4000. Return 201 with response DTO.
- `PUT /api/quick-replies/{id}` → `Admin, Manager`. 404 when missing.
- `DELETE /api/quick-replies/{id}` → `Admin, Manager`. Soft-delete by setting `IsActive = false` **or** hard delete — pick hard delete for MVP simplicity (matches how the Ticket module deletes secondary rows).
- Use `RequireAuthorization(policy)` matching existing patterns in `backend/CRM.Api/Auth/…` / `Program.cs`. Read `Program.cs` to confirm policy names.

Wire into `Program.cs` beside the other `Map*Endpoints(app)` calls.

## Edge Cases & Failure Modes

- **No quick replies** — `GET` returns `[]`; UI shows `quickReplies.empty`. Enforced in `QuickRepliesManagementView.vue` and the composer popover.
- **Quick reply deleted after list loaded** — Insert action operates on the local snapshot; no server call, so no failure. Refresh happens on next popover open.
- **Very long content** — Backend rejects > 4000 chars in `QuickReplyEndpoints.cs` create/update handlers. Frontend enforces the same via a `maxlength` and disabled Save.
- **Empty title/content** — Backend returns `ValidationProblem`; UI surfaces field errors under inputs.
- **Mention on non-InternalNote message** — Backend rejects with `ValidationProblem` in `TicketMessageEndpoints.cs`; UI hides mention chips when the type toggle is `Reply`.
- **Mentioned user does not exist / inactive / lacks CRM role** — Backend returns 400 with the offending id; UI shows `mentions.errors.invalid` and removes the chip.
- **Duplicate mention** — Server dedupes before persist; DB unique index on `(MessageId, UserId)` is the last line of defence.
- **Caller cannot access the ticket** — Reuses the existing ticket-access check in `TicketMessageEndpoints.cs`; returns 403.
- **Customer-facing surface** — Any endpoint that returns messages to customers must filter `Type == InternalNote`. Currently, no customer portal exists (per repo tree); mark this as **a follow-up review** if such an endpoint is added.
- **Mobile UI** — Popover collapses to a bottom drawer at `max-width: 640px` (verify with a Vitest snapshot).
- **Arabic RTL** — `dir="rtl"` inherited from the app shell; confirm `@` mention trigger still works when text direction is RTL.
- **API failure / DB failure** — All store actions catch and set `error`; components show a toast plus inline error copy from i18n.

## Migration / Rollback

- Two new EF Core migrations: `AddQuickReplies` (new `QuickReplyDbContext`) and `AddMessageMentions` (extends `TicketDbContext`).
- Both are additive; no destructive changes to existing tables.
- **Rollback:** `dotnet ef database update <previous>` per context. On a half-applied state (mentions table present but code rolled back), the extra rows are inert because the message endpoint ignores unknown fields. Manually drop `MessageMentions` and `QuickReplies` tables if a full rollback is required.
